title: The Real Architecture Behind Digital Product Stores with No-KYC Payments
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and digital downloads with automated crypto delivery — no platform middleman, no payout delays, no geographic filter.

content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, Venezuela, and Pakistan, digital creators face significant hurdles in selling their products online due to restrictions from platforms like PayPal and Stripe. This infrastructure gap leaves many without a reliable way to collect payments for their ebooks, courses, and digital downloads. The solution requires a sovereign approach, one that bypasses traditional payment gateways and leverages crypto payments, ensuring creators maintain full control and ownership over their digital storefronts.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

The concept of a sovereign digital product store revolves around the idea of independence from centralized platforms. It's about creators having the freedom to sell their products without the fear of account suspensions or payment freezes. This approach is crucial for those in regions where financial isolation is a harsh reality, offering a lifeline for digital entrepreneurs to reach a global audience without the constraints of traditional payment systems.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital store is built around a combination of free and paid tools. At its core, it utilizes GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. For file delivery, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 is used, while NOWPayments handles crypto transactions with a minimal 0.5% fee, supporting over 300 cryptocurrencies and requiring no KYC or buyer account.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives or delivered via hosted video links, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Sovereign digital stores empower creators with full control over their sales and customer data.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components include the frontend, which is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, providing a professional storefront. The backend, powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, handles the logic for order processing and product delivery. NOWPayments is integral for crypto payment processing, offering a seamless and low-fee transaction experience. Each component works in harmony to provide a seamless user experience for both the creator and the customer.

How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5-10%, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds. You receive 99.5% of the sale price directly into your self-custody wallet. No platform involved at any step.
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low 0.5% transaction fee.
